name: Redeemly
summary: Shopify app that rewards customers with cashback paid as Shopify's native store credit, with storewide programs, customer notifications and Shopify Flow templates, priced by total store orders.
best_for: Shopify stores that want to give cashback as Shopify's own store credit to bring customers back, starting free with up to 50 orders every 30 days
skip_if: you want a points, VIP or tiered loyalty program rather than store credit; or much of your revenue comes through subscriptions, the Shop app or POS, where the older FAQ says store credit cannot be used
honest_knock: Every order your store takes counts towards the plan allowance, not just the orders that earn cashback. Above the allowance each order costs $0.20, or $0.10 on Scale, and on Free the admin locks once you pass 50 orders in 30 days. Campaigns need Growth at $79. The older FAQ says store credit cannot pay recurring subscriptions or be used in the Shop app or on POS.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, billed every 30 days through Shopify in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-21 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/cashback-redeemly and on the Plans and billing article in Redeemly's help centre; prices in USD) Redeemly changed its plans on 3 November 2026. Stores that install now choose from four plans, each billed through Shopify every 30 days. Free costs $0 and includes 50 orders. Starter is $15 with 500 orders included, Growth is $79 with 1,000 and Scale is $199 with 2,500. Each order above the allowance costs $0.20, or $0.10 on Scale. The help article says every order counts, not just orders that earn credit, that the count starts when you turn on the cashback program and that it resets every 30 days. The plans now differ in features as well: widgets on the product page, cart and checkout, the referral program, the Klaviyo, Omnisend and Attentive connections and removal of Redeemly branding start on Starter, and campaigns start on Growth. Paid plans come with a 14-day free trial, once per store, the first time you choose one. On Free, going over 50 orders locks the Redeemly admin until the next 30 days start; paid plans do not lock. The help article says there are no other fees. Stores that installed before 3 November 2026 keep the earlier price table, which ran from $0 for up to 50 orders to $249 for 1,801 or more. We found no annual price.

schema_offer.description: Starter, billed every 30 days through Shopify in USD; Free $0 with 50 orders included; Starter $15 with 500 orders; Growth $79 with 1,000; Scale $199 with 2,500; each extra order $0.20, or $0.10 on Scale; plans for stores that installed on or after 3 November 2026. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-21.

compare_with.name: Loyalino
compare_with.why: Loyalino is in our dossiers too and solves retention with a points program instead: points on orders and actions, VIP tiers and referrals, with a free plan up to 200 orders a month and Starter at $29 a month or $290 a year up to 500 orders when we read it on 14 October 2026. Redeemly skips points and pays cashback straight into Shopify store credit, free up to 50 orders every 30 days and $15 with 500 orders included. If shoppers should collect and climb tiers, look at Loyalino; if you want a simple credit back on the next order, Redeemly.
